summary: Dual low-noise bipolar audio op-amp (5 nV/rtHz, 10 MHz GBW, drives 600 ohm), SOIC-8; a split-supply part (recommended VCC+ 5 to 15 V, VCC- -5 to -15 V), not a single +3V3 rail part. Supply ties are the circuit's choice: this entry gives only the per-pin bypass caps

cite.reading: SLOS075I gives no bypass guidance; 100nF per supply pin is the conventional value (TI's newer TL07x sheet SLOS080M p.17 says 0.1 uF) - confirm for this part
